slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training in that same year, or does each training jet produce a different number of pilots?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the pilot-training capacity of each training jet, and follow-up confirmed the rate is constant.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the total number of trained pilots available by the end of year 2 the sum of pilots trained in year 1 plus pilots trained in year 2, or do pilots trained in year 1 leave the system and only year 2 pilots count toward the final total?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the two-year training/accumulation timeline, but did not explicitly ask when training starts or how long training lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and the relevant training/production horizon is exactly two years, with pilots trained in both years counting toward the final total.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not explicitly ask about the training start year or duration; it listed the two-year timeline as a confirmed fact and then modeled year 1 and year 2 training.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot was resolved, but the P1 training start/duration slot was only partially touched and not fully confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent secured the critical per-jet training capacity, but did not ask about the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping and did not clearly confirm the training start/duration before stopping and presenting a model that assumes a two-year timeline.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
